stories.title: Man sentenced for critically injuring Ferguson officer Travis Brown in 2024
stories.summary: Elijah Gantt pleaded guilty to second-degree assault of a special victim and resisting/interfering with an arrest for a felony in July.

stories.title: Court approves $7.25 billion settlement with Bayer over claims Roundup weed killer caused cancer
stories.summary: Bayer will pay up to $7.25 billion over two decades to settle thousands of U.S. claims related to its weedkiller, Roundup.

stories.title: Woman killed by FedEx truck in possible road rage incident in Hazelwood, police say
stories.summary: Hazelwood police are talking to witnesses and are trying to obtain video of the incident. The investigation remains ongoing.

stories.title: St. Charles County leaders promote shopping local this holiday season
stories.summary: The mayors all agreed that shopping online is convenient, but nothing beats walking into a brick-and-mortar store in your own neighborhood.

stories.title: St. Louis Board of Aldermen passes pay hike for airport director, funds winter shelters, and backs school redevelopment
stories.summary: In a pre-holiday legislative session, the St. Louis Board of Aldermen advanced significant measures, including a major salary increase for the airport director.

stories.title: St. Louis County health director: Flu, RSV cases low now, but holiday spike expected
stories.summary: St. Louis County’s health director says flu and RSV cases are low now but expected to climb with holiday gatherings, urging vaccines for flu, COVID-19 and RSV.

stories.title: Driver strikes and kills Belleville man in marked crosswalk
stories.summary: A driver struck and killed a 55-year-old Belleville man Wednesday evening as he crossed South Green Mount Road in a marked crosswalk. The driver stayed at the scene.

stories.title: Mother speaks out as 22-Year-old crash victim fights in ICU following police pursuit
stories.summary: Family says Anthony Thurston faces at least two months before attempting to walk, questions need for high-speed police chases.

stories.title: Ferguson data center opponents say they’re still pursuing referendum petition, eligibility questioned
stories.summary: Organizers have until Monday to submit 98 additional signatures, but a city councilman says the proposed referendum is not allowed.

stories.title: St. Louis police shoot, kill man after he pointed BB gun at people, officers say
stories.summary: Police said officers repeatedly ordered him to get out of the vehicle and drop the weapon. When he refused, officers fired multiple shots, striking him.

stories.title: Nelly moving Black and White Ball out of St. Louis to a nearby venue
stories.summary: The hip-hop legend's celebration of St. Louis will move out of the city, he announced Thursday morning.

stories.title: Troopers seek information on fatal pedestrian crash in Wellston
stories.summary: The person's identity has not been released.
